# Source: Roses Quilt

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Roses Quilt
- **Artist / culture:** Letticia Keziah Vernon (American, 1795–1852) Virginia, Tennessee, or Missouri, United States
- **Date:** c. 1830/35
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** textile
- **Department:** Textiles
- **AIC artwork ID:** 2191
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/2191
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/6b027b41-147c-1685-13ce-cd2f4a766089/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Quilt

## Extracted source palette

`#D8D8D8, #B8B8B8, #989898, #787878, #383838, #585858, #F8F8F8, #181818`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#EFEFEF`
- `surface`: `#F9F9F9`
- `on_surface`: `#0F0F11`
- `primary`: `#383838`
- `on_primary`: `#F8F8F6`
- `secondary`: `#F8F8F8`
- `surface_variant`: `#D4D4D4`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#0F0F11`
- `outline`: `#B0B0B1`
- `error`: `#383838`
- `on_error`: `#F8F8F6`

- Font: `rounded` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `16dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `16.65:1`, surface `18.19:1`
- Variant contrast: `12.92:1`
- Control contrast: `11.03:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
